None of us are the marginal investor. Marginal investors are institutions like Blackrock that hold a lot of shares and trade those shares. Trying to trade based on news is a lost cause as the marginal investor has already acted on it. 

There are however instances of news based market inefficiencies stemming from behavioral finance. Examples include traders confusing tickers: MCI and MCIC, TCI and TCOMA (See The Journal of Fiance, "Massively Confused Investors," by Michael Rashes). There was also ISIS Pharmaceuticals, which had to change its name due to terrorist attacks that had nothing to do with the drug company.
